scope: C26 current default Avatar application HTTP/SSE and actual SQL actions, pinned same-family 4B/14B/32B. Known development replay, not heldout/human/physical approval.
sampling: All three models sequentially, one owned CUDA provider; fixed12 cases/20 application turns per model plus2 warmups. Provider call count observed, not assumed; no whole experiment wall deadline.
assessment: All turns with raw provider/SSE/visible/final/stored text, source-backed inventory and actual reminders. Span review separately labels unsupported execution, unsupported offer, draft/fiction, user report, negation/conditional, receipt-backed and ambiguous. No model self-score or lexical-only release approval. Service fallback is infrastructure failure.
